name: growthub-gtm
description: Use Growthub’s CEO, saved Characters, brand context and connected tools for real go-to-market work. Retrieve saved results and repeat accepted work through existing Routines.

interface.longDescription: Bring your saved Growthub team, approved brand context and business knowledge into real growth work. Direct a Character, retrieve its saved result and continue across supported Claude and Codex environments. Use existing scoped Growthub API tokens for supported MCP and API workflows, including private Brand Kit creation and review-only change proposals. Optional connected tools require their own existing accounts and permissions. Routine setup and publication stay in Growthub. ChatGPT web currently supports the existing Brand Kit OAuth connection; full CEO and Knowledge token connections depend on host support and public submission eligibility. See the connection guide before installing.

review.commerce_description: Existing Growthub subscription plans are purchased on Growthub’s website through its existing external Stripe checkout. This plugin does not collect card details or embed checkout. Connected AI providers and services may bill separately.

publication.release_notes: Growthub 0.1.2 adds scoped API-token workflows, clearer customer onboarding, three homepage-style illustrative use cases, and a clean migration path from legacy local developer tooling. Existing hosted MCP URLs, token references, providers and Routine controls remain unchanged.
